annotation.title_clean: 教育部等七部门关于印发《特殊教育发展提升“十五五”行动计划》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of Seven Ministries on Issuing the Special Education Development and Improvement Action Plan for the 15th Five-Year Plan Period
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 教育部 国家发展改革委 民政部 财政部 人力资源社会保障部 国家卫生健康委 中国残联
annotation.summary_en: Chinese seven-ministry action plan for special education during the 15th Five-Year Plan period (to 2030). It covers expanding access, inclusive placement, quality, teachers, funding and international cooperation, with a short section encouraging AI agents and human-machine collaboration in special education. It has no robotics governance content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Target of over 97% compulsory-education enrolment for school-age disabled children by 2030
Expand special education schools and inclusive placement with individualized plans
Encourage AI-enabled special education agents and human-machine collaborative teaching
Strengthen funding, teacher training and accessible school environments
Deepen international cooperation under Belt and Road
